title: App icons / Contribution

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Preserve consistency as a product portfolio grows, because each addition should remain distinguishable without inventing a new visual grammar.
strategic_value: The documented production and approval stages can keep IBM app icons coherent across libraries and product launches.
demonstration: Resource cards, design criteria, production requirements and approval stages form a text-led contribution guide.
practical_value: Prepare an original app-icon submission in the starter file and distinguish approval from later library publication.

content_islands.name: Resources
content_islands.spec: Present starter, Figma and builder cards below the contribution introduction.

content_islands.name: Design and production
content_islands.spec: List distinctness, accessibility and cross-platform requirements.

content_islands.name: Creating and delivering
content_islands.spec: Specify 32px artwork, 2px padding, grouped layers and Illustrator starter-file delivery.

content_islands.name: Approval and publication
content_islands.spec: Explain draft review, the approved Box asset link and later library sprint, ending with request actions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source links design and production guidance to consistency and proper formatting.
reference_purposes.Application: The page describes setup, layer grouping, file delivery and review steps.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Submissions require review; app icons use the Illustrator starter file and expanded strokes, with whole-pixel values.
